bullets.text: Cloud-Native App Development Revolutionized - **Microsoft** showcases building intelligent apps in under 30 minutes using **GitHub Copilot** and **VS Code**.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Update - New features including **Ask Copilot** in the taskbar enhance user experience on Windows 11.
Shared Audio Experience Launched - **Windows 11** now supports sharing audio between multiple Bluetooth devices using **LE Audio**.
Enhanced Scareware Protection - **Microsoft Edge** expands its **Scareware blocker** to protect users from scams effectively.
Mixed Reality Productivity Tools - **Windows** and **Meta Quest** integration enhances productivity in immersive environments.
New Edge for Business Connectors - **Microsoft Edge** introduces security connectors to enhance browser security for businesses.
AI Security Threats Explored - **Microsoft** releases an e-book detailing critical generative AI security threats organizations must address.
AI Evaluation Libraries Introduced - **Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Evaluation** libraries help developers ensure AI applications provide accurate outcomes.
Copilot Vision Update - **Microsoft Copilot** now allows text input for enhanced interaction on **Windows**.
Strengthening AI Partnerships - **Microsoft** and **OpenAI** announce a new agreement to further their collaboration in AI development.
